_readme: Prompts for the v2 slice audio upgrade (2026-09-27): regenerated slice tracks and new cues. Same format as prompts.json; run with
prompts.json stays the v1 list (one entry per R.Audio.IDS.bgm, checked by tools/test_media.js); new ids live only here.
status: regenerated = replaces assets/bgm/<id>.ogg (the previous file is kept in design/bgm/prev/), new = a new id (v2/design/bgm_changes.md says where it plays).
omen is a one-shot sting (json loop:false). Never name existing games, composers or songs here.
style_prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody.
negative: vocals, singing, lyrics, speech, choir words, crowd noise, vinyl crackle, lo-fi noise, fade-out, modern EDM drops, dubstep, distorted metal guitars, copyrighted melodies
suffix: Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.

tracks.scene: 迷いの森ヴェルダ（1〜2 階）
tracks.instrumentation: wooden flute lead, concert harp, marimba and kalimba droplets, soft hand percussion (frame drum, shaker), warm low strings, a clarinet answer in the second section
tracks.desc: The game's world lives in an endless night lit by lanterns, lamps and great beacon fires; the score is gentle and melancholic, with warmth and a quiet, stubborn hope. A lost forest at night: giant trunks, fireflies drifting between them, a forest that has forgotten its old songs and quietly moves its paths. Gentle wonder with a thread of unease, never scary. A breathy wooden flute sings a modal D-minor melody over a patient harp and marimba pattern; soft hand percussion walks like careful footsteps.
tracks.form: 4-bar harp and kalimba intro; section A flute melody; section B clarinet and strings take a new, more yearning melody in F major; a sparse interlude of marimba and fireflies-like kalimba; section A returns with fuller strings; the last bar leads back to section A

tracks.scene: 迷いの森の霧・森が道を変える時（不穏）
tracks.instrumentation: bowed vibraphone and glass harmonica tones, a music box playing fragments of a folk melody slightly out of reach, low cello drone, sul ponticello violins, distant wooden flute echoes, soft low taiko pulse, rustling rain stick
tracks.desc: The game's world lives in an endless night lit by lanterns, lamps and great beacon fires; the score is gentle and melancholic, with warmth and a quiet, stubborn hope. The lost forest when white fog rises and the paths rearrange themselves: eerie, hushed and disorienting, like a half-remembered lullaby heard from the wrong direction. Mysterious and uneasy but still delicate and beautiful, not horror; slow pulse, lots of space.
tracks.form: low drone and fog-like glass tones; music-box fragments; a slow pulse enters under distant flute calls; strings tighten into a quiet unresolved swell; back to the drone and music box

tracks.scene: 千年樹の中（ダンジョン、1〜2 階）
tracks.instrumentation: harp and hammered dulcimer ostinato, solo cello and wooden flute, soft wordless choir pad (no words), frame drum heartbeat, low contrabass, glockenspiel glints
tracks.desc: The game's world lives in an endless night lit by lanterns, lamps and great beacon fires; the score is gentle and melancholic, with warmth and a quiet, stubborn hope. Inside a thousand-year-old tree whose roots are being gnawed away: ancient, reverent and a little sorrowful, the slow heartbeat of the old tree spirit, glowing moss and roots. A dungeon theme with gentle forward motion, a noble cello melody answered by the flute.
tracks.form: dulcimer ostinato intro; cello theme; flute answer over the choir pad; a darker middle with the heartbeat drum and low strings; cello and flute together; back to the ostinato

tracks.scene: 港町ファロス（灯りの町）
tracks.instrumentation: accordion and clarinet melody, mandolin and fingerpicked guitar, harp, glockenspiel, walking upright bass, light brushes and tambourine
tracks.desc: The game's world lives in an endless night lit by lanterns, lamps and great beacon fires; the score is gentle and melancholic, with warmth and a quiet, stubborn hope. A harbour town under lamplight: lanterns along the pier, sailors, a market that never sees the sun, the smell of the sea. Friendly and warm with a touch of nostalgia, a gently swinging melody that feels like home port at night; lively but not loud.
tracks.form: 2-bar mandolin pickup; A melody on accordion; B melody on clarinet with harp, a little wistful; a short interlude with glockenspiel like harbour bells; A melody again with fuller band

tracks.instrumentation: climbing celesta and harp arpeggios, violin melody, cello counter-line, ticking woodblock and rim clicks, pizzicato strings, soft pads, low tom accents
tracks.desc: The game's world lives in an endless night lit by lanterns, lamps and great beacon fires; the score is gentle and melancholic, with warmth and a quiet, stubborn hope. Climbing a dark lighthouse tower whose lamp has gone out: rising spiral stairs, gears and old brass, the sea wind outside. Mysterious and determined, a sense of climbing toward a light that must be rekindled.
tracks.form: ticking intro; climbing theme on violin; a suspended middle where the cello takes the melody; a building passage with tom accents; return to the climbing theme

tracks.scene: 酒場・潮風亭（仲間選び）
tracks.instrumentation: fiddle and tin whistle melody, clarinet, strummed guitar, stomping frame drum (bodhran), upright bass, accordion chords
tracks.desc: The game's world lives in an endless night lit by lanterns, lamps and great beacon fires; the score is gentle and melancholic, with warmth and a quiet, stubborn hope. A cozy harbour tavern where adventurers gather and companions are recruited: warm firelight against the endless night outside, clinking mugs, a foot-tapping jig.
tracks.form: jig A, jig B, a softer C part with accordion, back to A

tracks.scene: 緊迫した場面（救出・予告）・ラザロ戦
tracks.instrumentation: sixteenth-note string ostinato, repeating low bass, long horn notes, clear drum beat, piano pulses, timpani swells
tracks.desc: The game's world lives in an endless night lit by lanterns, lamps and great beacon fires; the score is gentle and melancholic, with warmth and a quiet, stubborn hope. A tense story scene: suspense and urgency, someone must be saved, a clock is ticking, a clear driving beat. Build in waves so it does not feel like one repeated bar.
tracks.form: ostinato intro; section A with horn line; section B where the harmony moves to E-flat and the piano takes over; a peak with timpani; back to the ostinato

tracks.scene: 灯がともる・地方クリア（夜明けの予感）
tracks.instrumentation: concert harp, solo wooden flute, violins and cellos, french horn, soft timpani roll, glockenspiel and celesta sparkle
tracks.desc: The game's world lives in an endless night lit by lanterns, lamps and great beacon fires; the score is gentle and melancholic, with warmth and a quiet, stubborn hope. The moment a great beacon fire is lit again and the night sky pales a little: the storyteller's hopeful main theme, in the same waltz feel as the title music, starting intimate on harp and flute and blooming into warm strings and horn. Tender, grateful and luminous, like the first hint of a dawn nobody alive has seen.
tracks.form: harp arpeggio intro; theme on flute; strings and horn swell into the second phrase; a quiet celesta bridge; theme again with full warm orchestra settling softly

tracks.scene: ボスの予告（短いスティング、ループしない）
tracks.prompt: A short one-shot musical sting for a fantasy role-playing game, about eight seconds long: the moment a monstrous boss is heard gnawing in the dark before it appears. A deep low drum hit with a soft gong, a dissonant low string cluster that swells and rises, a high tremolo violin note and a brief muted brass stab, then the sound rings out and stops. Ominous but not a jump scare, orchestral, high quality. Instrumental only: no vocals, no spoken words. Duration: 8 seconds.

tracks.instrumentation: fingerpicked acoustic guitar, ocarina and soft pan flute, music box sparkle, gentle hand drum, warm cello and strings
tracks.desc: The storytellers' home village and the mentor's house: warm, homely and spiritual, lamplight in a quiet valley under a night sky, the wisdom of generations of storytellers. A gentle, nostalgic fingerpicked acoustic guitar waltz, with a soft ocarina or pan flute softly singing the storyteller's main theme, light hand percussion, and a warm bed of strings. Tender, earthy, safe.
tracks.form: guitar intro, ocarina theme, strings join, a second melody on pan flute, ocarina theme again, quiet return

tracks.scene: 灰色のマントの少女（フィーネ）の場面
tracks.instrumentation: solo celesta and harp, a soft solo violin, sustained string harmonics, a quiet low piano, faint chimes
tracks.desc: The game's world lives in an endless night lit by lanterns, lamps and great beacon fires; the score is gentle and melancholic, with warmth and a quiet, stubborn hope. The theme of a mysterious girl in a grey cloak who appears and vanishes like a figure from an old book: ethereal, tender and ancient, a little lonely, gently fading like a lamp's afterglow. Very quiet and intimate so dialogue sits on top of it.
tracks.form: celesta and harp motif; violin melody; harmonics and piano bridge; motif returns softly
